question.prompt: Points A, B, and C lie on the same line, with \(AB=10\text{ cm}\) and \(BC=4\text{ cm}\). What is the length of AC, in cm? (If there are multiple answers, separate them with commas, in any order.)

solutions.explanation: There are two cases: when C lies on the extension of AB, \(AC=10+4=14\); when C lies on segment AB, \(AC=10-4=6\).
solutions.title: Segment addition and subtraction
